limitations: These are liveness fixtures, not model performance or accuracy benchmarks.
The raw client probe is unchanged by this live-session patch.
TCP buffers, shared scheduling and debug serialization affect timing; these are individual observations, not percentile estimates.
Windows UI behavior is inferred from its synchronous call path until Windows build/tests run; no real microphone/UI session was exercised.
Async timeouts do not preempt synchronous work; a slow valid peer or scheduler pause can exceed the selected budget.
